summary: Ten devnet transactions: a DBC config and pool, a partial-fill buy that stops exactly at the graduation threshold, migration to DAMM v2, the graduation-proceeds claims, and the posting of those proceeds as an Equxi agent's bond.

steps.label: createConfig
steps.detail: DBC config: 1B supply, SOL quote, 1% base fee, 50% of trading fees to the creator, 10% migration fee with 50% to the creator.

steps.label: createPool
steps.detail: The token (EAGT) and its DBC pool. Graduation threshold: 0.698 SOL.

steps.label: buy (partial fill)
steps.detail: The final buy stops exactly at the threshold — DBC refuses a buy that would overshoot it, so it is sent as a partial fill. Curve: 100%.

steps.label: migrateToDammV2
steps.detail: Graduation into DAMM v2 with the dynamic-fee config — the pool moves to permanent liquidity.

steps.label: open fee account
steps.detail: The wrapped-SOL account the quote fees land in. It must exist before any claim or the token program rejects the credit.

steps.label: creatorWithdrawMigrationFee
steps.detail: The graduation proceeds, creator half: 10% of the graduated quote, split with the partner. This wallet moved +0.0698 SOL.

steps.label: partnerWithdrawMigrationFee
steps.detail: The partner half of the same 10% migration fee.

steps.label: register_agent
steps.detail: The launched token's agent on Equxi — the identity that will hold the collateral.

steps.label: unwrapWSOL
steps.detail: The proceeds come back as lamports so they can be handed to Equxi as SOL.

steps.label: create_bond
steps.detail: The launch proceeds become collateral: a 0.1 SOL Equxi bond, read back with the agent graded A / 92.
